claims.content: If the customer selects 'Daily View' from the Current Auctions Status Page, the system displays auction status updated once per day.
If the customer selects 'Hourly View' from the Current Auctions Status Page, the system displays auction status updated every hour.
If the customer requests a Sales Report, the system generates and displays sales data including order dates, amounts, and statuses.
If the customer requests a Competition Report, the system displays competitive bidding activity for selected auctions.
If the customer requests an Auctions RFM Report, the system displays Recency, Frequency, Monetary analysis of customer bidding behavior.
If the customer requests a Customer Ranking Report, the system displays ranked list of customers based on bidding or purchasing metrics.
If the customer requests an Inventory Performance & Aging Report, the system displays inventory turnover and aging statistics.
